highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 brings Skia m153 with Linux font-selection changes and GPU rendering corrections.

breaking.title: Pin fonts when fallback selection must be deterministic
breaking.body: On Linux, Skia tries FcFontMatch before the former FcFontSort fallback. Applications relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics. Select an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters; managed signatures and the native C ABI are unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the engine to milestone 153. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.
Prevents stale glyph-atlas reuse after partial updates and propagates Ganesh task, flush, and GPU-buffer upload failures rather than drawing stale data. Managed flush operations remain void.
Releases the cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding a native use-after-free.
Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Introduced Skia m153 and its Linux fallback-font selection change, and corrected cached-data mutex lifetime. The HarfBuzz package revision changes without a native HarfBuzz upgrade.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Prepared the m153 line for stable release with internal backport automation changes and no additional collected product changes.

harfbuzz_summary: Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, its Linux fallback-font selection change, and the cached-data mutex lifetime correction.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: The release candidate prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 finalizes glyph-atlas and GPU-buffer failure corrections.
v4.153.0.body: It also corrects the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
